subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw publish `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract with these field names and macOS permission semantics?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but the contract affects plugin-author API compatibility and future host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording grants.

options.title: Accept after repair and owner confirmation
options.body: Resolve the current branch conflict or use the rebased successor, regenerate the docs map, and confirm host code treats the metadata as discovery-only before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before freezing the public manifest surface.

options.title: Pause until host design settles
options.body: Keep the contract draft-only until macOS Computer Use host binding and trust boundaries are firmer.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Resolve the current branch conflict or use the rebased successor, regenerate the docs map, and confirm host code treats the metadata as discovery-only before merge.
